notes.title: Cataclysm: Major Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34165603/5ff86345196f46adb57db0ee0e8e0e952449845c.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]To make it easier to play and enjoy a deeper strategy, our development team has made big changes to the overall game balance.[/b][/h1]

The overall changes include:
[list]
[*] For better balance and fun, basic mechanisms such as Radioactivity, Overheat, Faith, Vampiric State, Command, and Guardians have been completely reinvented.
[*] To reduce the inconvenience and fatigue caused by relatively large numbers, we have worked on controlling the numerical inflation of all cards, skills and monsters.
[*] Each card and skill has been modified to have more characteristic performance.
[*] Monsters have been modified to have more different patterns.
[*] Excessive supply of skill points has been limited for the strategic fun of building a skill tree.
[*] The entire stage was reduced to 15 but each time the balance was adjusted to make it even more tense.
[*] Eliminated or modified unnecessary or redundant elements of the Battle UI.
[/list]
These modifications have made the overall difficulty higher than in the past, but they have a better balance, allowing us to go deeper into various strategies.

[i]Please give us a lot of feedback on the completely new Neoverse. We will continue to work hard for journey in the Neoverse, which includes more fun and suspenseful with your opinions.

notes.title: Major Update in May v0.981
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34165603/f77b22f960784fc0901ecd3a309d85e961725177.png[/img]
[h1]We have prepared a big change to give you more variety and fresher fun. With this update, players can make battle and growth more diverse. However, the overall difficulty became a bit difficult because of the various changes.
We have tested hard, but there have been a lot of changes and it could cause some bugs. Please give us many feedback.[/h1]

[h1][b]The adventure mode has been fully revised.[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] The battle is a total of 18 times.
[*] Options other than Battles such as Lap, Event, Supply and Etc. are removed.
[*] More difficult elite battles have been added, and you will be able to meet more powerful combinations of enemies and receive more rewards.
[*] Every time you start the stage, you will choose one 'Mission' and you will grow through mission rewards.
[*] Mission rewards are available in battle standby and can be used when needed.
[*] Related achievements have been removed or added.
[*] Some options of ‘Transcended Universe' will change.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34165603/b37ac3cd70a24cf6c2688e9e844f59008b71b361.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]A new combat technique called 'BattleTech' is added.[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Combo, Pairing, and precision three battle tactics are added.
[*] Depending on each condition, there is an effect that will help combat the battle.
[*] Click on the combo information at the top of the screen to see all BattleTech.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34165603/2ad959ad973a5c6e9b60248caf4a148f4bb9371d.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Combat Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] The remaining armor will no longer disappear.
[*]  The related cards and monster patterns will change.
[*]  Enemies have more patterns and buffs.
[/list]

[h1][b]Numerous cards and skills change.[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] All cards and skills are used more frequently and efficiently, and balance is adjusted.
[*] About 150 cards have been modified.
[*] About 40 skills are modified.
[/list]

[h1][b]Skill acquisition method has been changed.[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Skill Tree is a structure similar to bingo.
[*] All legendary skills are unidentified and placed in the weighted right and bottom lines of the 25 skill lists.
[*] If you activate all the remaining skills on the same line as the legendary skill, the legendary skill will be identified and can be purchased.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34165603/c5caef9e34dc86ed06e5436077271a64169b25e2.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Bug Fix[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the mouse was centered when keyboard was operated.
[*] The modeling of some monsters in the second chapter has been replaced.
[*] Fixed some text translation errors.
[/list]

[/h1]
